title: Dust and gas content of high-redshift galaxies hosting obscured AGN in the Chandra Deep Field-South
question: How much do the dust and gas of the host ISM contribute to the nuclear obscuration of X-ray selected, FIR-detected obscured AGN at z>2.5 in the CDF-S, and what are their sizes and kinematics?

data.sensitivity: requested ~180 uJy/beam line (200 km/s), 20 uJy/beam continuum

what.value: X-ray column densities, SED-derived gas masses, stellar masses, SFRs

evidence.quote: (9) (10) (11) Gas mass, infrared SED-fitting column density, and X-ray spectral fitting column density, respectively, derived by (cite: circosta_2019).

what.value: CO SLED line ratios for SMG and QSO

evidence.quote: We use ratios between the observed and CO(1-0) lines reported in Table 2 of (cite: carilli_2013)

what.value: L'1-0 vs L850um relation and alpha_850
UV-to-MIR photometry used in SED fit

evidence.quote: taken from the UV-to mid-IR (MIR) provided by (cite: hsu_2014)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline in CASA 4.7.0-1 with manual inspection

recipe.goal: Image CO line and dust continuum
recipe.method: Continuum-subtract line spw, image with velocity-mode and mfs, robust weighting chosen as tradeoff of sensitivity and resolution
Gaussian fits of line spectrum; moments 0,1,2 over v0±FWHM with 3 sigma threshold
2-D elliptical Gaussian fit to images, then to visibilities with image fit as starting values; position fixed in second fit
Optically thin dust emission with Td from single MBB SED fit
assumptions: k_nu=4[nu/1.2THz]^beta, beta=2.0; Td error ~5 K; upper limit 3 rms

recipe.goal: Gas mass from CO and continuum
recipe.method: L'CO from Solomon 1992; convert to L'1-0 with SMG/QSO CO SLED; M_H2=alpha_CO L'1-0 (0.8 and 6.5), add HI = H2/5; continuum via Scoville L850 relation with RJ MBB scaling
assumptions: alpha_CO=0.8 (and 6.5), M_H2/M_HI=5, beta=2, nu0=1.5 THz, undetected line width 400 km/s

recipe.method: Uniform sphere: density=Mgas/V, divide by proton mass, path length = radius, diameter = mean of major and minor axes
assumptions: Undetected sources assumed mean sizes of detected ones

recipe.method: Thin disk relation from Wang 2013 using FWHM (XID 42, 539) or vc,proj (XID 666)

evidence.quote: From the CO(5–4) line we derived a redshift $z$ = 2.94355 $\pm$ 0.00001

not_stated_but_needed: CASA task parameters: cell size, image size, deconvolver, masks, cleaning threshold
Line-free channel choice for the continuum image and polynomial order
Exact spw/channel selections for the continuum images
SED photometric fluxes and fitting priors for MBB
Details of the HeII redshift re-analysis
Inclination derivation details beyond axial ratios
missing_for_reproduction: CASA clean parameters (cell, imsize, masks, thresholds)
score_reason: Data identified and recipe largely described, but imaging parameters and SED fitting inputs are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Data from a single public project; recipe mostly clear with numeric results (fluxes, sizes, masses), though some imaging details are missing.
